## Activity

During July 2026, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 86 captures. This activity provides the basis for the monthly review of image quality and grading performance. The service should continue to monitor capture volumes and ensure that completed images are available for review in a timely manner.

## Image quality

Of the images submitted, 8 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 9.3. The clinic should review the circumstances associated with these images and identify any recurring technical or procedural issues. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so they can be tracked and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results during July 2026. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly, while referable results should continue to be managed through the appropriate follow-up process. The service should maintain oversight of both image quality and grading timeliness in future reporting periods.
